name: Total CMS
desc: Flat-file content management system for websites, with collections, blogs, images and files.

actions.name: list_collections
actions.description: Lists all collections on the site.

actions.name: get_collection_schema
actions.description: Lists the fields of a collection, with their types.

actions.name: find_objects
actions.description: Searches, filters and sorts the objects of a collection.

actions.name: get_content
actions.description: Gets one object (all its fields) from a collection.

actions.name: create_object
actions.description: Creates a new object in any collection.

actions.name: update_object
actions.description: Changes some fields of an object and keeps the others.

actions.name: clone_object
actions.description: Copies an object under a new ID.

actions.name: delete_object
actions.description: Permanently deletes an object and its files.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.description: Uploads a file or image to an image, gallery, file or depot field of an object.

actions.name: adjust_number
actions.description: Adds to or subtracts from a number field, such as a counter or stock level.

actions.name: get_blog_post
actions.description: Gets a blog post with its full content.

actions.name: save_blog_post
actions.description: Creates a blog post, or updates the post with the given ID.

actions.name: save_blog_image
actions.description: Uploads the main image of a blog post, replacing the current one.

actions.name: save_blog_gallery
actions.displayName: Add Image to Blog Post Gallery
actions.description: Adds an image to the gallery of a blog post.

actions.name: save_text
actions.description: Creates or replaces a text object.

actions.name: save_toggle
actions.description: Turns a toggle object on or off.

actions.name: save_date
actions.description: Creates or replaces a date object.

actions.name: save_image
actions.description: Uploads an image to an image object, replacing the current image.

actions.name: save_gallery
actions.description: Adds an image to a gallery object.

actions.name: save_file
actions.description: Uploads a file to a file object, replacing the current file.

actions.name: save_depot
actions.description: Adds a file to a depot (file library) object.

actions.name: save_video
actions.description: Creates or replaces a video object from a video link.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_blog_post
triggers.description: Triggers when a new post is added to a blog.

triggers.name: new_object
triggers.description: Triggers when an object is added to a collection.

triggers.name: updated_object
triggers.description: Triggers when an object in a collection is changed.
